state.paragraph: On September 3, 2013, members of Mac-Gray management, representatives from BofA Merrill Lynch and representatives of Party A participated in a telephone conference call for Party A to conduct follow-up and confirmatory due diligence.

ledger_rows.Note: Information access differs by bidder type: B and C (financial) get broad data-room access; A and CSC/Pamplona (strategic) get limited access, customer data withheld, plus synergy talks. All four had management presentations 08/06-08/14.
Letter to all four (authorized 08/15): revised written proposals due 09/09/2013 to go on to in-depth evaluation. Proposals to cover valuation, financing, approvals, covenants and diligence.
Revised IOI, up from $18.50 (#18). Pamplona commits 100% of the capital. Requests 2-week exclusivity. Heavy: customer data still withheld and further in-depth diligence expected.
Revised IOI, up from $17.00-$18.00 (#21). Financing from affiliated-fund equity plus third-party debt; no firm financing commitment (Heavy).
Due date for revised written proposals. CSC/Pamplona and Party B bid on time; Party A and Party C bid on 09/10 and were reviewed on 09/11 (late bids accepted).
Revised IOI, one day late; same range as its 06/21 proposal (#7). To be financed by existing credit facilities or affiliated equity; no firm financing commitment (Heavy).
Revised oral IOI to BofA, one day late; revises #24 ($16.00-$16.50). No firm financing commitment (Heavy).

Rollover refused by holder: CEO and major holder says he won't roll over shares. BofA reports bidders unlikely to proceed without his support; committee has him fully briefed (09/12). He backs the process, wants higher value.
BofA calls all four the same day asking for final IOIs by 09/18/2013. Short exclusivity offered to one bidder depending on price and deal certainty.
Due date for final IOIs, reached. On 09/19 the committee acted on the bids in hand (enforced).

nda_access.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
